clarifications.question: Is the invitation replay an emergent social simulation?
clarifications.answer: No. It is deterministic supplied replay; the source also scripts its invitation path.

clarifications.question: Can a future lower-sequence memory be discarded after a higher sequence is consumed?
clarifications.answer: No. Progress records exact consumed source identities, so that memory becomes pending when available.

clarifications.question: Does a reflection text prove that its conclusion follows logically?
clarifications.answer: No. Only source eligibility, citation and state-transition provenance are tested.

clarifications.question: Does a plan patch replace every segment?
clarifications.answer: No. Only targets contradicted by the actual reflection citations are affected; missing replacements remain unresolved.

clarifications.question: Does a venue check reserve all future actions?
clarifications.answer: No. It executes finite currently active actions at one supplied simulated now, threading actual occupancy in declared order.

clarifications.question: Are calendar events real calendar writes?
clarifications.answer: No. This is a restricted complete local SIMULATED calendar feed.

proof_limits: Finite typed local contracts do not establish unscripted emergence, believability, ToM, social quality or logical reflection entailment
Normal-process directory reopen is not crash atomicity, and the restricted local calendar is not full RFC conformance or external calendar delivery
The 60-minute distribution is an estimate without human interview calibration
Local measured double margins do not prove arbitrary wallclock bounds or productionSLA
